rating.description: The learner's rating (PRD §10.2); null until rated.
rating.title: Rating

run_id.description: The ask's trace id in Phoenix, for attaching a rating (#227); null for turns kept before it was recorded.
run_id.title: Run Id

get.description: A cited passage for the viewer's highlight (PRD §8 US-4b, §9.3 step 5), through a readable document only.

The caller's documents, newest first, narrowed by any subset of the filters (PRD §8 US-10).

`subject_id` and `state` repeat; a document matches when it has any of the subjects and is in any of the states.
`uploaded_from` and `uploaded_to` are inclusive calendar days in the app time zone (D27). The filters combine.
Active documents by default; `archived=true` lists the archived ones.

post.description:
Whether the caller's own library already holds this file, so the browser can skip the upload (PRD §8 US-2).

Another learner's copy is never reported or linked; the server-side hash decides after upload (D19).

delete.description:
Delete the caller's document for good: its PDF, page text, and chunks (PRD §8 US-10c).

Refused while processing (409). Conversations keep their text and list it as deleted.

get.description: The caller's document with its facts, summary, and subjects, archived or not (PRD §8 US-10).

post.description:
Archive the caller's document: it leaves search and My subjects; content and chunks stay (PRD §8 US-10).

Archiving an archived document changes nothing.

get.description: A 5-minute link to the PDF for the document viewer (PRD §8 US-4b, §9.3 step 5); archived documents open too.

post.description: Bring an archived document back into search and My subjects; restoring an active one changes nothing.
Process a failed document's stored file again (PRD §9.5); a document that isn't failed is left as it is.

get.description: Three ranked subjects for a processed document, for the learner to choose from (PRD §8 US-2b).

put.description:
Save the learner's 1-3 subjects; the document becomes ready to use (PRD §8 US-2b).

A ready document's subjects change without processing it again; an archived document's are refused (409) until it
is restored (PRD §8 US-10).
Set the caller's display title for this document, or clear it with null; their library only (PRD §9.4).

get.description: The caller's subjects matching `q` (by their names), then other shared subjects (canonical names).

The learner's active conversations, or with `archived=true` the archived ones, newest last activity first
(PRD US-13): title, subjects of the documents used (deleted ones excluded), number of documents, last activity.

`subject_id` repeats; a conversation matches when any of its listed documents that still exist has any of them.
`active_from` and `active_to` are inclusive calendar days of last activity in the app time zone (D27). `q` is a
case-insensitive part of the title; answers are not searched (Q63). The filters combine; blank `q` is ignored.

200.description: Server-sent events: thread, then delta*, citations, done; or decline then done (no_documents: nothing readable, upload first; limited: the listed documents don't cover it); or error.

404.description: A document that isn't the caller's ready one.

get.description: The learner's conversation: its title and search scope (PRD US-4c).

patch.description: Rename the learner's conversation (PRD US-13) and/or limit its search to its documents (US-4c).

409.description: The conversation is archived, or has no documents to limit the search to.

422.description: Nothing to change, or the title is empty or longer than 120 characters.

post.description:
Archive the learner's conversation (PRD US-13): it leaves the active list and becomes read-only; its history,
documents used, and title stay. Archiving an archived one changes nothing.

get.description: The conversation's documents: those its answers drew on and those the learner added (PRD US-4b, US-4c).

post.description: Add the learner's ready, non-archived documents to the conversation's list (PRD US-4c); returns the list.

404.description: Not the caller's conversation, or a document that isn't their ready one.

delete.description: Take a document off the conversation's list (PRD US-4c); the document and old citations are unchanged.

post.description:
Ask in the learner's conversation (US-4c): a limited conversation searches only its listed documents, whose
ids are read here, never from the question.

200.description: Server-sent events: thread, then delta*, citations, done; or decline then done (no_documents: nothing readable, upload first; limited: the listed documents don't cover it); or error.

post.description: Restore the learner's archived conversation: active again; restoring an active one changes nothing.

get.description:
The conversation's turns, oldest first: each question with its answer and citations, or its decline (PRD
US-13). Citations resolve now: display title, archived, or "Deleted document".

put.description:
Rate an answer or decline of the learner's conversation helpful ("up") or not ("down"); a new rating replaces
the last (PRD §10.2). Saved with the turn (#290 sends it to Phoenix).

404.description: Not the caller's conversation, or no such answer in it.

get.description: The per-file limits, so the browser can refuse a file before uploading it (PRD §8 US-2).
The caller's upload limits and, when one is reached, which and until when (PRD §11, US-9).
What became of the caller's upload; a duplicate points to the document they already have (PRD §8 US-11).

post.description:
Add one to today's count. Takes no body and stores nothing about the caller: the route needs a signed-in
learner only to keep the endpoint from being open to the internet.
